exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean core u, r>=1 fresh point controls with p=2^(-r), F=1+A_r(u-1), and finite adaptive physical core-only restriction tree T, the lifted actual leaf partition obeys Pi_I(F)=p*Pi_I(u) and |Pi_H(F)-p*Pi_H(u)|<=(12+8/ln(2))*Pi_I(F), with all remaining-core entropy and terminal control reserve retained. For proper-core stopping trees with Pi_H(u)<=K*Pi_I(u) and C001-regular core terminals, H(F)<=max(K+12+8/ln(2),C_reg)*I(F). In particular u=chi_[t]*g with t>=1 and regular g on at least one remaining core coordinate admits the proper character-block rule H(F)<=(12+8/ln(2))*I(F), even for g=D_s where core density tends to zero. A universal forward activation surcharge exactly 4 is refuted by the actual proper-core example u=z*D_32, r=16: the certified Pi_H(F)/Pi_I(F)>8193/2048 while Pi_H(u)=0. The iterated r->infinity then s->infinity surcharge limit on u=z*D_s is 4.
